delaySeconds.description: Seconds to wait before starting visitor data purging. This can be used as a safety measure in case the request needs to be canceled.

emails.description: List of emails for which visitor data will be purged.

userIds.description: List of user IDs (external user IDs) for which visitor data will be purged.

visitorIds.description: List of visitor IDs for which visitor data will be purged.
